name: Faraday EMC Review
description: One-click EMC design review of the current board, running locally in your browser.
description_full: Adds a 'Review in Faraday' button that opens the current board in Faraday (faraday.openconverters.com): coupled-run crosstalk, return-path breaks, commutation loops, via stubs, a 2D field-solver bench, radiated-emission estimates against CISPR/FCC limit lines, near-field victim analysis and PDN impedance. The board file is served to the browser from localhost only — the analysis runs in WASM on your machine and nothing is uploaded.
